notes.title: Join our second playtest and get a limited edition hat!
notes.content:
Claim your very own head warmer by joining our little town of Berwick on Saturday the 12th of October at 3pm and 8pm UTC+1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738105/50f3534f5d01fab0429b3addb1f25733a4b88c8c.png[/img]

[h2]What to do:[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435100/Sweetlads_Werewolf/  

•	Press that big green request access button on Steam page above 
•	Download the game,
•	And Join us this Saturday!

[h2]Frequently asked questions:[/h2]

Q: What platforms do you support?
A: Windows, we will build Mac OS and Linux builds for the full release

Q: Why am I lagging?
A: We only have one server based in the UK so you may see a delay in other regions. Either way, please report this on the survey you'll receive access to when playing!

Q: If I turn up to both events, can I get two hats?
A: Only 1 hat can be claimed per Steam account

[h2]Update:[/h2]

Upon seeing the diverse global turn-out, we decided to generate localisation using Google Translate. We will get an expert to translate for the full release

Supported languages:
english
español
français
deutsch
português
русский
한국어
中文

Can’t wait? Follow us for updates:
Discord: https://discord.gg/TvUDBnzbdV
X: https://x.com/Sweetlads_WW
